sections.title: Habit and foliage
sections.text: Rhodotypos scandens, jetbead, is a deciduous shrub about 0.9–1.8 m tall and 1.2–2.4 m wide, with opposite, sharply toothed leaves and arching branches.

sections.title: Flowers and fruit
sections.text: Its white, four-petaled flowers are about 3–5 cm across. Each flower can develop into a cluster of glossy black, bead-like drupes, each around 8 mm.

sections.title: Caution
sections.text: The black fruits are reported as toxic and are not edible. This East Asian shrub has escaped cultivation and is invasive in parts of North America and Europe.
